title: duabanga grandiflora
intro: Duabanga grandiflora, commonly known as the Daun Jeruk Nipis or Daun Jering in some parts of Asia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lythraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Duabanga grandiflora include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
